If you’ve ever felt that sudden surge of energy, inspiration, enthusiasm, optimism, sense of almost infinite possibilities and potential…

But then your life (or the perception of it) returned to the mundane normal without any lasting change acquired from the sudden moment of elevation…

Then this one is for you.

Swipe to read.

@recovering.overthinker

Used to believe in this so much myself till I realized I have to follow the vision of the one who made me. We’re too flawed to “trust our vision” entirely. 

You need to start spamming yourself with God’s vision for your life. 

“The heart is deceitful above all things and beyond cure. Who can understand it?”
‭‭Jeremiah‬ ‭17‬:‭9‬ ‭
